title: First/final variance values appear beneath incorrect column headers
reasoning: Headers contain all first-checkpoint metrics followed by all final-checkpoint metrics, but row values alternate first and final for each metric. Consequently, most values are labeled as the wrong metric or checkpoint boundary, misleading comparisons.
reproduction: Render a summary with distinct first and final values for every metric. The second numeric cell contains final Pass rate but is headed Lint first CV.
recommendation: Construct headers and row values in the same order, either both interleaved or both grouped.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing rendering test checks titles and header presence only; it also uses identical first and final dictionaries and never validates cell-to-header correspondence.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand the rendering scenario to use unique values for each metric and boundary, then assert their correspondence to the table columns.
minimumFixScope: Align column ordering in _render_problem_cv_summary and strengthen its existing test.
